name: soleon-admin
description: The full Soleon surface for platform administrators. Everything in soleon-builder, plus the admin-only families: channel and custom-MCP instance reads, eval runs, and the discovery workspace. Consent only — what you can actually do is still decided by your Soleon permissions.

server_url.title: Soleon MCP server URL
server_url.description: Which Soleon system to connect to. Defaults to the dev system, which works out of the box. Changing this ALONE will break sign-in: each system registers its own OAuth client, and the client ID cannot be set from this screen. To use another environment, add the server with both values instead — `claude mcp add --transport http <url> --client-id <id>` (see the plugin README).
